title: In a Twitter shareholder trial, former CEO Parag Agrawal and CFO Ned Segal disputed Musk's claims that they lied to him about the percentage of spam accounts (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: In a Twitter shareholder trial, former CEO Parag Agrawal and CFO Ned Segal disputed Musk's claims that they lied to him about the percentage of spam accounts — Two former top executives at Twitter Inc. sought to beat back Elon Musk's narrative at a jury trial that they lied to him about the makeup …
